rule: Only these exact files may be published. There is no wildcard permission. Every private/ path is excluded, even if its bytes are identified by public metadata.
explicit_own_control_exception: Standalone own Python controls and verifier, own prose/derivations, their safe JSON receipts, and runtime/source/inventory metadata are allowed. No raw external body, header, PDF, full extract, render, or API/search response is allowed.
integrity_rule: Final manifest plus detached SHA is noncircular; complete final inventory covers integrity artifacts with one explicit self-hash exception.
